info.name: worker-service
info.description: Rusuh Booking Tiket — Worker Service (port 8084). Kafka consumer only — tidak ada HTTP endpoint publik selain health check.

request.description: Cek apakah worker-service hidup. Worker tidak expose HTTP endpoint untuk business logic — semua via Kafka consumer.

item.name: Kafka Events (Reference — tidak bisa di-hit via HTTP)

request.description:
BUKAN endpoint HTTP. Ini dokumentasi Kafka event yang di-consume worker.

Topic: `booking.created`
Triggered by: booking-service saat POST /api/v1/bookings berhasil.

Payload:
```json
{
  "bookingId": "550e8400-...",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "paymentExpiresAt": "2026-10-23T14:00:00Z",
  "items": [
    {
      "categoryId": "CAT-VIP",
      "ticketCode": "TKT-VIP-001",
      "nik": "3273010101900001",
      "price": 500000
    }
  ]
}
```

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #1 'Instruksi Pembayaran' ke `email`.

BUKAN endpoint HTTP. Ini dokumentasi Kafka event.

Topic: `payment.succeeded`
Triggered by: payment-service saat Midtrans callback settlement.

Payload:
```json
{
  "paymentId": "660e8400-...",
  "bookingId": "550e8400-...",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "method": "qris",
  "items": [
    {
      "categoryId": "CAT-VIP",
      "ticketCode": "TKT-VIP-001",
      "nik": "3273010101900001",
      "nama": "Budi Santoso",
      "price": 500000
    }
  ]
}
```

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #2 'E-Tiket Boarding Pass' ke `email`.
Idempotency: `sync.Map` key = `bookingId:payment_succeeded` (1 email per booking).

BUKAN endpoint HTTP. Ini dokumentasi Kafka event.

Topic: `payment.expired`
Triggered by: payment-service TTL sweeper atau Midtrans callback expire/cancel.

Payload:
```json
{
  "bookingId": "550e8400-...",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "reason": "PAYMENT_TTL"
}
```

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #3 'Booking Dibatalkan' ke `email`.
Idempotency: 1 email per booking.

Retry topics:
- `booking.created.retry`
- `payment.succeeded.retry`
- `payment.expired.retry`

DLT topics:
- `booking.created.dlt`
- `payment.succeeded.dlt`
- `payment.expired.dlt`

Logika: gagal kirim email → publish ke `.retry` (max 3x, backoff 5s/10s/20s) → setelah 3x publish ke `.dlt`.

Header tracking: `X-Retry-Count` per message.
